tasks.short: Obtain and study clinical and family histories

steps.what: Obtain medical, psychological, social and family histories through interviews
Study histories and review records for clinically meaningful patterns

tasks.design: Keep interviewing and clinical study of histories with the psychologist. Existing {DOCS} records support interpretation; speech-driven reporting does not establish a shorter interview or clinical review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Meaning depends on relationships, chronology and conflicting accounts.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access helps but no new capability is assumed to replace clinical interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive disclosures, incomplete records and inconsistent recollections.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust, ask follow-up questions and understand the person's context.
tasks.altitude: Clinical history-taking responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Separate documented facts from uncertain recollections

evidence.claim: The digest reports speech-driven reporting in Dutch mental health providers; this does not establish a reduction in interviewing or studying histories.

assumptions: Boundary is psychologist interviews and clinical record study, excluding separate note-writing and diagnostic decisions. No invented documentation component is assigned a saving.
Psychologist produces elicited history in s1 with capture and clarification time fully retained; no structured history profile is assumed.
Check native record access first. Unchanged history work adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which discrepancies need direct clarification with the individual or family?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=60+40=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Interviews and clinical study retain all time; a documentation capability is not counted as a history-taking saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select, administer, score and interpret psychological tests

steps.what: Select psychological tests appropriate to the assessment question and individual
Administer selected tests and verify response and administration records
Score verified psychological test responses using licensed rules and norm tables
Check scoring validity and interpret test findings in clinical context

tasks.design: Use licensed native scoring in the {OTHER} psychological assessment system for explicit rules and authorised norm tables. The psychologist selects and administers tests, checks validity and interprets findings; the software does not diagnose or choose tests.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual arithmetic and norm lookup repeat fixed scoring rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic scoring is plausible where licensed native scoring and applicable norms are available.
tasks.still_hard: Invalid administration, inapplicable norms and interpretation beyond scores.
tasks.human_edge: Judge validity and explain what findings do and do not support.
tasks.altitude: Less manual scoring only; assessment and diagnostic responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess test validity and norm applicability

evidence.claim: Licensed deterministic test scoring is plausible model knowledge; no named scoring product or measured local saving is supplied in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary includes psychologist test selection, administration, scoring and interpretation, excluding test participant time and downstream treatment.

Psychologist produces response/item values, test and form version, administration conditions, required demographic norm selectors and validity flags in s2. Its full 35 hours include entry, response verification and norm-selector confirmation; no free structured responses are assumed.

Licensed publisher rules and norm tables are mandatory. Test native scoring first; unsupported forms, missing responses or uncertain norm applicability return to manual authorised scoring and interpretation.
Existing automatic scoring earns no new saving. The scenario applies only where a genuine 20-hour manual scoring component remains.
Five additional focal hours cover scoring samples and norm/version checks; two assessment-administration hours cover additional licensed configuration upkeep.
unknowns: Test mix and licensed native scoring
research_questions: Does licensed scoring remove arithmetic effort after complete response capture and validity checks?

already_counted.description: Score validity review and clinical interpretation

approvals.approved_version: Exact response record, scoring rule and norm versions, scores, validity assessment and interpretation; changes void confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+35+0+25=80, gross=20, focal upkeep=5, net=15. High requires licensed repeat scoring currently done manually; low retains manual scoring for unsupported or invalid administrations plus upkeep. Selection, administration and interpretation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Consult textbooks, manuals and journals for relevant clinical evidence
Apply reference evidence to symptoms, diagnosis or treatment approaches

tasks.design: Retain clinical reading and case-specific application of {DOCS} reference material. Research-screening tools may reorder articles, but that does not establish a shorter diagnostic or treatment reasoning process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Published evidence must be assessed for relevance and limitations in this case.
tasks.enabler_now: Literature screening support exists but is not assumed equivalent to clinical reference interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting findings and uncertain applicability to an individual.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate evidence quality and avoid turning a general finding into an unsupported clinical conclusion.
tasks.altitude: Clinical evidence interpretation and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Check study population and methodological applicability

evidence.claim: ASReview prioritises literature-screening records; this does not validate diagnosis or treatment reasoning from clinical references.

assumptions: Boundary is psychologist clinical reference consultation and application, excluding a separate systematic review or report-writing task.
Psychologist produces the evidence assessment in s1 with reading and capture time fully retained. No structured symptom-to-diagnosis rules or automatic recommendation is assumed.
Use native reference search first. Retained reading and interpretation create zero new upkeep.
research_questions: Which reference-search actions are separable from necessary clinical reading and reasoning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+55=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Relevant reading and clinical application retain all time; research-screening benchmarks are not transferred to diagnosis.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult other clinicians about patient care

steps.what: Consult with or provide consultation to clinicians regarding patient care

tasks.design: Retain clinician consultation and joint reasoning. Existing {DOCS} findings support discussion without assuming a separate note-drafting burden or shorter clinical conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical teams need to reconcile different perspectives and incomplete evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: No validated replacement for this clinical consultation appears in the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting interpretations, confidentiality and unclear responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Explain psychological reasoning and recognise when colleagues need further clarification.
tasks.altitude: Consultation authority and professional communication time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Clinical consultation remains human work; speech-driven record drafting does not establish shorter joint reasoning.

assumptions: Boundary is psychologist consultation time, excluding colleague time and separate report production.
Clinicians provide their accounts during existing care processes; no structured care-decision input or automated advice is assumed.
Use native authorised record access first. Unchanged consultation adds no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which uncertainties require direct multidisciplinary discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Direct clinical consultation retains all psychologist effort and colleague time is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Licensed manual test scoring may shrink; interviews, clinical reading, interpretation and colleague consultation remain professional work.
reach: Review test validity limits with neuropsychologists
Discuss clinical evidence applicability with medical scientists
skills_to_grow: Separating arithmetic savings from clinical judgement
role.ambitious_version: A psychologist with traceable test scoring who retains responsibility for individual understanding, clinical interpretation and collaborative care.
